verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that anyone can publish and consume providers, modules, and policies on the public Terraform Registry. Publishers sign in with a GitHub account, the Registry offers search and tier filtering, and modules are the documented way to create reusable configurations. Community comments about public modules being overly complex criticize their quality, not whether the capability exists. Missing for 10: documented detail on how modules are consumed in configuration (source/version pinning, download during init — only provider auto-download is evidenced), and depth on the publishing workflow beyond GitHub sign-in (versioning/release requirements).
